warningMessages.message:
Passengers who occupy emergency seats must:
  • Cooperate with the crew in the event of an evacuation of the aircraft
  • Be capable of opening the emergency exit and assist the rest of the passengers in the evacuation
  • Not require assistance in hearing and understanding verbal instructions
  • Understand the instructions printed on the emergency exits and the directions of the crew
Do you accept the conditions required to occupy an emergency exit seat?
This seat is reserved for passengers with reduced mobility. You may be obliged to move to another one.
